newsitem.title: FRENCH GUIANA: Guyanor to be listed on Paris Nouveau Marche.
newsitem.headline: Guyanor to be listed on Paris Nouveau Marche.

text.p: Guyanor Ressources S.A. a mineral exploration and mining company operating in the French overseas department of Guiana said it obtained preliminary permission to be listed on Paris' Nouveau Marche.
The firm's Denver-based parent company, Golden Star Resources Ltd said in a statement its initial offer was for up to 1.5 million class B shares.

"Regulatory authorities in France approved a preliminary prospectus which entitles Guyanor to list its Class B common shares for trading on the Nouveau Marche of the Bourse of Paris, and to offer for sale in France up to 1.5 million of its Class B shares," the statement said.

"Subject to obtaining the approval of the Commission des Operations de Bourse (COB) ... trading of Guyanor's Class B shares on the Nouveau Marche will begin on October 30," it said. Golden Star operates in the Guiana shield region of South America as well as in several west African states.
It holds a 30 percent interest in the Omai gold mine in Guyana (former British Guiana), one of the largest producing gold mines in South America.

Golden Star said it holds a 70 percent interest in Guyanor and invested $7 million dollars in French Guiana during 1995, mostly in labor and associated cost, equipment and transport to remote mine locations.
